167: The incident of the first calf” — refers to the entire episode of the Golden Calf up until the verse ‘and I threw it into the fire’ (Exodus 32:24). What follows, when Aaron recounts the story again, is called ‘the incident of the second calf’, as in the verse ‘and this calf came out’ (Exodus 32:24). This verse should not be translated [into Aramaic in public], lest the common people be misled and think that the calf literally emerged by itself [miraculously]. But the [Hebrew] verse itself need not be avoided, since they do not understand it deeply anyway.
